Orenburg vs CSKA Moskva Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Orenburg welcome CSKA Moskva to Gazovik Stadium on 1 November 2026 for a Russian Premier League fixture scheduled to kick off at 10:00 UTC. Orenburg sit sixth in the table with 16 points from 12 matches, while CSKA Moskva occupy third place with 25 points from 12 outings. The hosts have lost only twice this season but have drawn seven times, whereas the visitors have suffered just one defeat and are on a five-match unbeaten run (W-L-W-W-D). This meeting continues a rivalry in which CSKA have historically held a clear advantage.

Why This Match Matters

CSKA Moskva are firmly in the title conversation, nine points behind leaders Dinamo Moskva but with a game in hand. A win would keep them within striking distance of the top two and maintain pressure on Zenit in second. Orenburg, meanwhile, are six points adrift of the European places and will view this as an opportunity to close the gap on the teams above them. The hosts have not beaten CSKA in the league since April 2019, so a positive result would also carry significant psychological weight. Both sides have defensive records among the better halves of the division — Orenburg have conceded 12 goals, CSKA 12 — suggesting the match could be decided by fine margins.

Lokomotiv vs AGMK Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Lokomotiv welcome AGMK to Tashkent on 1 November 2026 for a Uzbekistan Super League fixture scheduled to kick off at 11:00 UTC. The match takes place at Lokomotiv Stadium, the regular home ground of Lokomotiv Tashkent. Both sides sit in the upper half of the table, with AGMK sixth on 42 points and Lokomotiv seventh on 40 points after 25 matches each. A win for either team would strengthen their push for a top-five finish and potential continental qualification.

The reverse fixture in April 2026 ended 2-1 to AGMK, continuing a recent trend where the visitors have won three of the last four league meetings. Lokomotiv will aim to reverse that run on home soil, where they have historically held the advantage in this rivalry.

Why This Match Matters

AGMK occupy sixth place with 42 points from 25 games (12 wins, 6 draws, 7 losses), two points clear of Lokomotiv in seventh on 40 points (11 wins, 7 draws, 7 losses). Both teams are within striking distance of the top five, which would secure a spot in the AFC Champions League qualifying rounds. With only a handful of rounds remaining, this direct encounter carries significant weight in the race for continental football.

AGMK arrive with a slightly better recent league form (WWDWL) compared to Lokomotiv (DDWLW). However, Lokomotiv boast a superior goal difference (+9 vs +4) and have scored four more goals overall. The head-to-head record could become a tie-breaker if the teams finish level on points, adding further importance to the result.
